run_model_evaluation: run model evaluation on a TF2 checkpoint against a TFRecord dataset and log metrics
run_evaluation_with_time_filter: run model evaluation filtered to custom merger time intervals like [[-0.2,0],[0.5,1]]
run_evaluation_default_interval: run model evaluation using the default merger time interval of [-1,1]
review_main: review the main function that orchestrates checkpoint evaluation via the galaxy_mergers evaluator module
review_evaluator_integration: review how main calls evaluator.get_config_dataset_evaluator and evaluator.run_model_on_dataset to produce metrics
